2010-the-autobiography-of-charles-darwin.creator: Charles Darwin
2010-the-autobiography-of-charles-darwin.description: A book by Charles Darwin. ly interest my children or their children. I know that it would have interested me greatly to have read even so short and dull a sketch of the mind of my grandfather, written by himself, and what he thought and did, and how he worked.

37124-a-foreword-to-the-panama-pacific-i.title: Exposition
37124-a-foreword-to-the-panama-pacific-i.creator: Juliet L. James
37124-a-foreword-to-the-panama-pacific-i.description: A book by Juliet L. James. They had dug and delved with mighty _Hercules_ and had created that great gap that has severed two continents. Then, leaving their work to be finished, they had sailed on to celebrate their triumph in the _Land of El Dorado_ the region of their desires.

arxiv-1808-06675.title: Class2Str: End to End Latent Hierarchy Learning
arxiv-1808-06675.creator: Soham Saha 1 2 , Girish Varma 1 3 and C.V. Jawahar 4
arxiv-1808-06675.description: Abstract Deep neural networks for image classification typically consists of a convolutional feature extractor followed by a fully connected classifier network. The predicted and the ground truth labels are represented as one hot vectors. Such a representation assumes that all classes are equally dissimilar. However, classes have visual similarities and often form a hierarchy.

arxiv-1907-09607.title: Semi-Supervised Learning by Disentangling and Self-Ensembling over Stochastic Latent Space
arxiv-1907-09607.creator: Prashnna Kumar Gyawali *, Zhiyuan Li *, Sandesh Ghimire, Linwei Wang
arxiv-1907-09607.description: Abstract The success of deep learning in medical imaging is mostly achieved at the cost of a large labeled data set. Semi-supervised learning (SSL) provides a promising solution by leveraging the structure of unlabeled data to improve learning from a small set of labeled data.

arxiv-2208-03217.title: Distance-based detection of out-of-distribution silent failures for Covid-19 lung lesion segmentation Journal: Medical Image Analysis
arxiv-2208-03217.creator: Camila González, Karol Gotkowski, Moritz Fuchs, Andreas Bucher, Armin Dadras, Ricarda Fischbach, Isabel Jasmin Kaltenborn, Anirban Mukhopadhyay
arxiv-2208-03217.description: Abstract Automatic segmentation of ground glass opacities and consolidations in chest computer tomography (CT) scans can potentially ease the burden of radiologists during times of high resource utilisation. However, deep learning models are not trusted in the clinical routine due to failing silently on out-of-distribution (OOD) data.

arxiv-2305-05202.title: Multi-messenger observations of double neutron stars in Galactic disk with gravitational and radio waves
arxiv-2305-05202.creator: Wen-Fan Feng, Jie-Wen Chen, Yan Wang, Soumya D. Mohanty, Yong Shao
arxiv-2305-05202.description: Abstract We evaluate the prospects for radio follow-up of the double neutron stars (DNSs) in the Galactic disk that could be detected through future space-borne gravitational wave (GW) detectors. We first simulate the DNS population in the Galactic disk that is accessible to space-borne GW detectors according to the merger rate from recent LIGO results.

arxiv-2308-01485.title: A new probabilistic analysis of the yard-sale model
arxiv-2308-01485.creator: Christoph Börgers
arxiv-2308-01485.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Christoph Börgers. 1 Department of Mathematics, Tufts University, Medford, MA 2 Two Sigma Investments, LP, New York, NY, and Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences, New York University, New York, NY Abstract. In Chakraborti’s yard sale model of an economy [ 6 ] , identical agents engage in trades that result in wealth exchanges, but conserve the combined wealth of all agents and each agent’s expected wealth.

arxiv-2310-11982.title: On the estimation of persistence intensity functions and linear representations of persistence diagrams
arxiv-2310-11982.creator: Weichen Wu, Jisu Kim, Alessandro Rinaldo
arxiv-2310-11982.description: Abstract Persistence diagrams are one of the most popular types of data summaries used in Topological Data Analysis. The prevailing statistical approach to analyzing persistence diagrams is concerned with filtering out topological noise. In this paper, we adopt a different viewpoint and aim at estimating the actual distribution of a random persistence diagram, which captures both topological signal and noise.

arxiv-2501-15106.title: Solving Optimal Execution Problems via In-Context Operator Networks
arxiv-2501-15106.creator: Tingwei Meng, Moritz Voss, Nils Detering, Stanley Osher, Georg Menz
arxiv-2501-15106.description: Abstract We propose a novel transformer-based neural network architecture (ICON-OCnet) for solving optimal order execution problems in the presence of unknown price impact. Our architecture facilitates data-driven in-context operator learning for the incurred price impact by merging offline pre-training with online few-shot prompting inference.

arxiv-2503-06405.title: Heterogeneous bimodal attention fusion for speech emotion recognition
arxiv-2503-06405.creator: Jiachen Luo, Huy Phan, Lin Wang, Joshua Reiss*
arxiv-2503-06405.description: Abstract Multi-modal emotion recognition in conversations is a challenging problem due to the complex and complementary interactions between different modalities. Audio and textual cues are particularly important for understanding emotions from a human perspective. Most existing studies focus on exploring interactions between audio and text modalities at the same representation level.

arxiv-2505-09455.title: Beyond Pixels: Leveraging the Language of Soccer to Improve Spatio-Temporal Action Detection in Broadcast Videos
arxiv-2505-09455.creator: Jeremie Ochin, Raphael Chekroun, Bogdan Stanciulescu, Sotiris Manitsaris
arxiv-2505-09455.description: Abstract State-of-the-art spatio-temporal action detection (STAD) methods show promising results for extracting soccer events from broadcast videos. However, when operated in the high-recall, low-precision regime required for exhaustive event coverage in soccer analytics, their lack of contextual understanding becomes apparent: many false positives could be resolved by considering a broader sequence of actions and game-state information.

arxiv-2506-16980.title: Resonance fluorescence and indistinguishable photons from a coherently driven B centre in hBN
arxiv-2506-16980.creator: Domitille Gérard 1 , Stéphanie Buil 1 , Kenji Watanabe 2 , Takashi Taniguchi 3 , Jean-Pierre Hermier 1 , Aymeric Delteil 1
arxiv-2506-16980.description: Abstract Optically active defects in hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) have become amongst the most attractive single-photon emitters in the solid state, owing to their high-quality photophysical properties, combined with the unlimited possibilities of integration offered by the host two-dimensional material.

arxiv-2512-19102.title: The Simons Observatory: Detector Polarization Angle Calibration using Sparse Wire Grid with Initial Data Sets of the Small Aperture Telescope
arxiv-2512-19102.creator: Hironobu Nakata, Shunsuke Adachi, Kyohei Yamada, Michael Randall, Yutaro Kasai, Kam Arnold, Bryce Bixler, Yuji Chinone, Kevin T. Crowley, Nadia Dachlythra, Samuel Day-Weiss, Nicholas Galitzki, Serena Giardiello, Bradley R. Johnson, Brian Keating, Brian J. Koopman, Akito Kusaka, Jack Lashner, Federic
arxiv-2512-19102.description: Abstract Improved measurements of B B -modes in the cosmic microwave background can be obtained through accurate calibration of the orientation of detector antennas as projected onto the sky. Miscalibration of the detector polarization angle leads to a leakage of E E -modes into B B -modes, which can bias the detection of the latter.

pmc-10603082.description: The fifth edition of the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders (DSM-5), published in 2013, includes an alternative model of personality disorders (AMPD) focusing on a maladaptive trait model utilized to diagnose several personality disorders. Borderline personality disorder (BPD) and antisocial personality disorder (ASPD) are two conditions categorized by AMPD that exhibit high rates of violence and aggression.

pmc-11488242.title: Implementation of a tailored multifaceted antibiotic stewardship intervention to improve antibiotic prescribing for urinary tract infections in frail older adults (ImpresU) in four European countries: a process evaluation alongside a pragmatic cluster randomized controlled trial
pmc-11488242.creator: Esther A R Hartman, Wim G Groen, Silje Rebekka Heltveit-Olsen, Morten Lindbæk, Sigurd Høye, Sara Sofia Lithén, Pär-Daniel Sundvall, Sofia Sundvall, Egill Snaebjörnsson Arnljots, Ronny Gunnarsson, Anna Kowalczyk, Maciej Godycki-Cwirko, Alma C van de Pol, Tamara N Platteel, Annelie A Monnier, Theo J M
pmc-11488242.description: BackgroundWe previously performed a pragmatic cluster randomized controlled trial (RCT) in general practices and older adult care organizations in Poland, the Netherlands, Norway, and Sweden. We found that a multifaceted antibiotic stewardship intervention (ASI) substantially reduced antibiotic use for suspected urinary tract infections (UTIs) in frail older adults compared with usual care.

pmc-11530488.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundDigital therapeutics (DTx) have attracted attention as the substitutes or add-ons to conventional pharmacotherapy and the number of DTx products authorized with the regulatory reviews of the clinical evidence is increasing. Insomnia is one of the major targets of the DTx due to the benefit from cognitive behavioral interventions and several products have been launched in the market with regulatory reviews.

pmc-11687124.title: Efficacy of preoperative prophylactic application of betamethasone on postoperative nausea and vomiting in patients undergoing total knee arthroplasty: a prospective randomized controlled trial
pmc-11687124.creator: Xiaobo Sun, Qunli Dou, Bowei Li, Guoyang Bai, Kai Qin, Jianbing Ma, Fudong Yao, Yuanchi Huang
pmc-11687124.description: BackgroundThe demand for total knee arthroplasty (TKA) is increasing, yet postoperative nausea and vomiting (PONV) significantly hinder patient recovery. Preoperative prophylactic administration of glucocorticoids can alleviate PONV, with betamethasone showing promising results in breast and cardiac surgeries. However, its efficacy in TKA patients remains unclear.

pmc-12412336.title: Odor Reduction Drives Transition to Heat-Not-Burn Tobacco Products in Poland
pmc-12412336.creator: Natalia Miller, Piotr Samel-Kowalik, Bolesław Samoliński
pmc-12412336.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe World Health Organization has identified tobacco smoking as a major global health crisis, responsible for over 8 million deaths annually and posing significant public health, social, and economic challenges. In response, harm reduction strategies, including the use of heated tobacco products (HnB), have gained attention as potential tools to mitigate the adverse health effects of smoking by offering less harmful alternatives to conventional cigarettes.

pmc-12491548.title: Persistent neuromuscular disorders associated with changes in tibialis anterior and gastrocnemius lateralis muscle architecture in long-covid: an observational longitudinal study

pmc-12491548.description: Long COVID-19 causes complications, affecting quality of life and work capacity. However, its long-term impact on lower limb neuromuscular function remains unclear. To evaluate neuromuscular electrophysiological disorders (NEDs) and muscle architecture of the tibialis anterior (TA) and triceps surae (TS) in individuals with moderate or severe COVID-19 compared to control group over 12 months.

pmc-13026411.title: Representation learning for the prediction of length of stay in infants with congenital heart diseases undergoing cardiac surgery
pmc-13026411.creator: Adriana Modrego, Esther Aurensanz-Clemente, Julia Meca-Santamaria, Roger Domingo-Espinós, Arnau Valls-Esteve, Joan Sanchez-de-Toledo, Bart Bijnens, Patricia Garcia-Canadilla
pmc-13026411.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). AimsCongenital heart disease is the most common birth defect and significantly impacts health, mortality, and healthcare costs. Accurately estimating intensive care unit (ICU) and hospital stays after cardiac surgery could facilitate family planning and optimal healthcare resource allocation. Although some perioperative risk factors have been associated with prolonged stays, tools to estimate the length of stay for the target population remain insufficient.

pmc-13079406.title: Dietary Vitamin B6 Intake and Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease: A Case–Control Study
pmc-13079406.creator: Amirhesam Mehrara, Saba Moradi, Masoumeh Dorosti, Leila Dehghanian, Masoumeh Sadat MirShafaie, Mohammadreza Esfahanian, Bita Moradi, Ali Nouri, Sara Khoshdooz, Parsa Bahmani, Saeid Doaei, Maryam Gholamalizadeh
pmc-13079406.description: BackgroundGastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) is a common gastrointestinal disorder influenced by various dietary factors. This study aimed to evaluate the association between dietary intake of vitamin B6 and the risk of GERD.MethodsThis case–control study included 150 women with GERD and 300 controls in Tehran, Iran.

pmc-13201780.title: A CEL simulation approach for penetration-leveling of the multi-bucket foundation incorporating the temperature analogy method
pmc-13201780.creator: Kunpeng Gao, Zhiyuan Cheng, Kun Yu, Yu Qiu
pmc-13201780.description: The multi-bucket foundation is widely used in offshore engineering, and the foundation inclination during installation necessitates leveling to ensure its bearing capacity. Although the numerical simulation offers an efficient and rapid approach of validating leveling strategies, the significant large deformation during foundation leveling makes conventional approaches unable to directly simulate, let alone reliably capture the associated seepage distribution characteristics.

pmc-13460714.creator: Adam Karkoutli, Daniel E Bestourous, Mana Espahbodi, Neil S Patel, Matthew L Carlson, Richard K Gurgel
